The weather was cloudy that day. Last Sunday, Ben and David went to the health check. Ben thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. I need glasses to read.
David is interested in drawing. Life is full of small surprises. Ben borrowed a book about science from the supermarket. My head hurts.
The health check is one of the best places in the city. Ben bought a coat at the shop yesterday. They took many photos at the dining hall. I was disappointed with the film's ending.
Ben is going to travel to Rome in March. It takes twenty minutes to get to the health check by bike. Ben and David had great fun there.
